note: Release plan from 0.2.16 to the end of the 0.2.x series, then 0.3.0. Proposed 2026-11-05; each row's scope becomes that cycle's goals and checklist when the cycle opens. Items name rows of artifacts/todo_stack.md, artifacts/roadmap.md or artifacts/open_stack.md.

releases.goal: Every defect the November audits and the GitHub issues found is fixed with a failing test first.
scope: Audit findings repaired, each with a test that fails on the old code
GitHub issues #35 to #39 fixed; a file without /units raises TableNotFoundError
granger solves on the GPU with a parity test; granger_causality removed
UnitAnalyzer.psth bins right-open [a, b), as bin_spikes does (results change)
Validations on external ground truth: vflip2 on the Bastos lab simulation, delay and direction from a broadband jaxfne field, real-data cards with independent receipts
needs: the Bastos lab simulation code and a broadband jaxfne field
a ruling on the jnwb.lab proposal (#40)

releases.goal: Less code and prose for the same behaviour: one home per helper, lower complexity, consistent style.
scope: The largest functions (xflip, jrsa, zflip, vflip, phase_slope_index) split below a stated complexity
One home per helper in jnwb, scripts and tests; dead code and unused constants removed
Tests named by subject, not by the event that produced them
Docs and examples thinned; one home per invariant across the rule and doc files
Code and prose matched to the style standards; the fact graph build made faster
needs: decisions on public names that dead-code removal touches

releases.goal: Every estimand choice a function makes silently is named, decided and tested.
scope: Response z-score standard deviation (ddof), trial-cycle gap threshold, reference row order: one decision each, then code
gaussian_smooth_rate NaN handling
Time and frequency parameters carry unit suffixes; one name per concept (window, bin, sampling rate)
needs: a decision on each estimand choice and on the public parameter names

releases.goal: Every test runs on some CI leg, or is declared as not run there with its reason.
scope: Tests that skip on every leg (validate extra, torch and jax, the Dryad parity data, Chromium, GPU) run on one leg or are declared
Tiered CI: fast checks on every push, the full matrix where it qualifies a release
Python 3.15 on Windows once h5py publishes cp315 wheels
needs: approval of the tiered CI plan

releases.goal: Reproductions kept outside jnwb show their figures and results on the dashboard, read from committed records.
scope: Paper2Agent-GLO (Bastos lab): figures and per-figure scores in the OpenScope GLO tab
Showcase and calibration files reduced to the receipts of record
needs: the GLO figures and results from the Bastos lab

releases.goal: One rule per concern and one name per concept; the repository continues from the remote alone.
scope: Rule pairs that disagree reconciled, one ruling each
Stack form matched to the shared template; no tracked file depends on a local one
One name per concept in rules and tooling; every flow step has a performer and a check
needs: rulings on the rule pairs and the stack form

releases.goal: The last 0.2 release: no new features; the surface is reviewed and the 0.3.0 changes are listed.
scope: Every public symbol reviewed for name, signature and documentation; deprecations completed
The independently verified set extended to the functions settled in 0.2.16 to 0.2.21
The breaking changes collected during 0.2.x listed as the 0.3.0 candidates

releases.goal: Scope set by ruling at the close of 0.2.22, from the candidates collected during the 0.2 series.
